## 2. Pre-declared contrasts — the decisions

Each interval is a paired block bootstrap on the *difference*, both models scored on the same resampled test blocks. An interval spanning zero means this experiment cannot separate the two models; that is a result, and it is the honest thing to write.


#### P0  −  N3

assembly check: model 3 with the graph off must reproduce model 2's N3. Expect 0.0000 exactly, not 'close' — the two networks are byte-identical at seed 0. Any difference at all means the wiring is wrong and every rung below is uninterpretable

> Not available: N3 has not been run.


#### P0_x5 x5  −  N5_bce x5

the same check at 5 seeds: model 3's graph-free ensemble against model 2's headline

> Not available: N5_bce x5 has not been run.


#### P1  −  P0

do the 204 spatial k-NN edges help at all?

**B wins** (-0.0872, 95% CI [-0.1074, -0.0680])

> Paired block bootstrap, 5355 (node × fortnight) blocks, 2000 draws, p = 0.000.


#### P2  −  P1

RQ1a — do the 35 directed flow edges add anything over spatial edges alone? This is the topology question the proposal is built on

**not resolved** (-0.0035, 95% CI [-0.0203, +0.0123] spans zero) — this experiment cannot separate them; more seeds or a larger test block would be needed to

> Paired block bootstrap, 5355 (node × fortnight) blocks, 2000 draws, p = 0.668.


#### P3 x5  −  P0_x5 x5

> Paired block bootstrap, 5355 (node × fortnight) blocks, 2000 draws, p = 0.000.

## 5. Claims this evidence supports

Each claim is paired with the caveat that has to travel with it. A claim whose contrast in §2 spans zero does not belong here.

| claim | evidence | the caveat that must accompany it |
|---|---|---|
| Random splits do not merely inflate scores, they select a different model | PR-AUC 0.704 → 0.905 under a random split while pre-onset ev.det collapses 0.380 → 0.089 | one seed per arm; the effect is large enough to survive that, the exact numbers are not |
| The input layer, not depth, is what loses to gradient-boosted trees | N0 → N1 (periodic embeddings, nothing else changed) = +0.152 PR-AUC | single seeds; the size of the gap, not its precise value, is the claim |
| Focal loss is a defect on this task, not a cost | N5 → N5_bce = +0.0509 PR-AUC, ECE cut to a third, same architecture and seeds | shown on model 2; confirm on model 1 via the M5_bce contrast in §2 |
| PR-AUC on a 1-day flood target measures persistence more than skill | `discharge_pctl` alone scores 0.816; GBT 0.8496 | this is why §3 and the onset head exist — lead with them |
| SAR imagery does not help at a 1-day horizon | M6_cnn null; N6_gated at 17× the parameters scores below N5_bce | 9 of 51 nodes, ~12-day revisit — a coverage result, not a statement about SAR in general |
